```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
load(here("Data","cbb_AS26_expt_1000bs.RData"))
load(here("Data", "Alls.cor_clean.RData"))
#load(here("Data", "TUT_seq.csv"))

cluster_summary<-read.csv(here("Data", "expt_data_clustered.csv"))
ed50_data<-read.csv(file = here("Data", "AS26_ED50_CI_BIC_TAO.csv"))%>%
# 2. Rename PhPh_Genotype to match your clean ID column, and clean up the text casing
  dplyr::rename(SampleID_clean = PhPh_Genotype) %>% 
  mutate(SampleID_clean = tolower(trimws(SampleID_clean))) %>% 
  # 3. Keep only the ID and the ED50 score
  dplyr::select(SampleID_clean, ED50)

#add ed50 data
annot_master <- cluster_summary %>%
  mutate(SampleID_clean = tolower(trimws(SampleID_clean))) %>%
  left_join(ed50_data, by = "SampleID_clean")

# Grab the hclust object directly from your pvclust output
my_hclust <- cbb$hclust

# Clean the labels directly on the hclust object so it stays the correct data type
my_hclust$labels <- my_hclust$labels %>%
  tolower() %>%
  sub("\\.processed\\.csv$", "", .) %>%
  sub("\\._?\\d{2,3}r$", "", .) %>%
  trimws()

# Keep track of this order for matching data frames
dend_order_labels <- my_hclust$labels


# --- 2. Align the physiological matrix data ---
# Match the rows of your clean numeric matrix to the exact order of the hclust labels
heatmap_matrix <- Alls.cor_clean[match(cbb$hclust$labels, rownames(Alls.cor_clean)), ] %>%
  as.matrix()

# Transpose and scale (z-score) so traits are rows
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- t(scale(heatmap_matrix))
# Add this line right after you create heatmap_matrix_scaled!
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled > 3]  <- 3
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled < -3] <- -3

# Assign the cleaned labels as the column names of the matrix
colnames(heatmap_matrix_scaled) <- dend_order_labels


# --- 3. Align the cluster metadata annotations ---


annotation_col <- annot_master %>%
  filter(SampleID_clean %in% dend_order_labels) %>%
  slice(match(dend_order_labels, SampleID_clean)) %>%
  # Select metadata, your cluster level, AND the continuous ED50 column
  dplyr::select(SampleID_clean, species, K_12, ED50)

annotation_col <- annotation_col %>%
  mutate(ED50_capped = ifelse(ED50 > 39, 39, ED50)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ED50)
# Establish row names for pheatmap and strip the raw ID column
annotation_col <- as.data.frame(annotation_col)
rownames(annotation_col) <- annotation_col$SampleID_clean
annotation_col$SampleID_clean <- NULL

# Convert categorical features to factors, keeping ED50 numeric
annotation_col <- annotation_col %>% 
  mutate(across(c(species, K_12), as.factor))


# Explicitly match the row names to the matrix columns
#rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)
# rownames(annotation_col) <- annotation_col$SampleID_clean
# annotation_col$SampleID_clean <- NULL


# --- 1. Filter out Fm/Fo and isolate your 9 metrics ---
metric_names <- rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)
keep_metrics <- metric_names[!metric_names %in% c("Fm", "Fo", "fm", "fo")]
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- heatmap_matrix_scaled[keep_metrics, ]


# --- 2. Build the Row Annotation and Category Labels ---
metric_names <- rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)

annotation_row <- data.frame(Metric = case_when(
  grepl("Quant",   metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Quant (Quantum Yield)",
  grepl("Sigma",   metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Sigma (Antenna Size)",
  grepl("Connect", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Connect (Connectivity)",
  grepl("Tau1",    metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Tau1 (Transport Kinetics 1)",
  grepl("Tau2",    metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Tau2 (Transport Kinetics 2)",
  grepl("NPQ",     metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "NPQ (Non-Photochemical Quenching)",
  grepl("qP",      metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "qP (Photochemical Quenching)",
  grepl("ABQ",     metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "ABQ (Absorption)",
  grepl("qm",      metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "qm (Max Quenching)",
  TRUE                                               ~ "Other Metric"
))
rownames(annotation_row) <- metric_names


# --- 3. CRITICAL: Sort both the Matrix and Annotation by Metric Category ---
# This orders the metrics alphabetically by their clean group names
sorted_order <- order(annotation_row$Metric)

heatmap_matrix_scaled <- heatmap_matrix_scaled[sorted_order, ]
annotation_row        <- annotation_row[sorted_order, , drop = FALSE]


# --- 4. Export the Sorted Heatmap ---
jpeg(
  file = here("Plots", "Sorted_Grouped_Physiological_Heatmap_k12only.jpg"), 
  width = 12, 
  height = 10, 
  units = "in", 
  res = 300
)

pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix_scaled,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_row = annotation_row,
  show_colnames  = FALSE,         
  show_rownames  = FALSE,          # <--- Turn this back to TRUE to see them!
  cluster_rows   = FALSE,         
  cluster_cols   = my_hclust,     
  #color          = my_palette,           
  #breaks         = my_breaks,           
  main           = "Sorted MAPP Fluorescence Metrics vs. Genetic Clusters",
  margins        = c(5, 20)       # <--- [Column_Margin, Row_Margin]. Increase 12 if names are long!
)

dev.off()


```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)

# --- 1. Filter Matrix for Your Specific Metrics ---
# Get the row names currently in your matrix
metric_names <- rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)

# Filter out Fm and Fo if they are lingering in your matrix
keep_metrics <- metric_names[!metric_names %in% c("Fm", "Fo", "fm", "fo")]
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- heatmap_matrix_scaled[keep_metrics, ]

# --- 2. Create the Custom Biological Groupings (Rows) ---
# Re-evaluate the trimmed row names
metric_names <- rownames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)

annotation_row <- data.frame(Metric_Type = case_when(
  grepl("Quant|ABQ", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)           ~ "Quantum Yield / Absorption",
  grepl("Sigma|Connect|nCon", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)  ~ "Antenna Size & Connectivity",
  grepl("Tau|nTau", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)            ~ "Electron Transport Kinetics",
  grepl("NPQ|qP|qm", metric_names, ignore.case = TRUE)           ~ "Photochemical & Non-Photochemical Quenching",
  TRUE ~ "Other Metrics"
))

# Match row names perfectly
rownames(annotation_row) <- metric_names

# --- 3. Run the Final Heatmap ---
pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix_scaled,
  annotation_col = annotation_col, # Your K-cluster columns at the top
  annotation_row = annotation_row, # Your functional PAM metric groupings on the left
  show_colnames  = FALSE,          
  show_rownames  = TRUE,           # Prints Quant, Sigma, Tau, etc., on the right
  fontsize_row   = 9,              
  cluster_rows   = TRUE,           # Clusters the metrics by how they behave
  cluster_cols   = my_hclust,      # Locked to your custom CBB bootstrap tree
  color          = my_palette,           
  breaks         = my_breaks,           
  main           = "PAM Fluorescence Metrics vs. Genetic K-Clusters"
)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)

# --- 1. Fix the labels inside the actual hclust object ---
# Grab the hclust object directly from your pvclust output
my_hclust <- cbb$hclust

# Clean the labels directly on the hclust object so it stays the correct data type
my_hclust$labels <- my_hclust$labels %>%
  tolower() %>%
  sub("\\.processed\\.csv$", "", .) %>%
  sub("\\._?\\d{2,3}r$", "", .) %>%
  trimws()

# Keep track of this order for matching data frames
dend_order_labels <- my_hclust$labels


# --- 2. Align the physiological matrix data ---
# Match the rows of your clean numeric matrix to the exact order of the hclust labels
heatmap_matrix <- Alls.cor_clean[match(cbb$hclust$labels, rownames(Alls.cor_clean)), ] %>%
  as.matrix()

# Transpose and scale (z-score) so traits are rows
heatmap_matrix_scaled <- t(scale(heatmap_matrix))
# Add this line right after you create heatmap_matrix_scaled!
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled > 3]  <- 3
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled < -3] <- -3

# Assign the cleaned labels as the column names of the matrix
colnames(heatmap_matrix_scaled) <- dend_order_labels


# --- 3. Align the cluster metadata annotations ---
annotation_col <- cluster_summary %>%
  mutate(SampleID_clean = tolower(trimws(SampleID_clean))) %>%
  filter(SampleID_clean %in% dend_order_labels) %>%
  slice(match(dend_order_labels, SampleID_clean)) %>%
  dplyr::select(species, K_2:K_15) %>% # Toggle your K's here
  mutate(across(everything(), as.factor)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Explicitly match the row names to the matrix columns
rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)


# --- 4. Run the Heatmap ---
pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix_scaled,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  show_colnames = FALSE,         
  cluster_rows = TRUE,           
  cluster_cols = my_hclust,      # <--- Passing the adjusted hclust object fixes the type error!
  main = "Physiological Profiles Ordered by CBB Dendrogram"
)


##or
# Cap the outliers first
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled > 3]  <- 3
heatmap_matrix_scaled[heatmap_matrix_scaled < -3] <- -3

# Define the high-contrast colors and breaks
my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "white", "darkred"))(100)
my_breaks <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101)

# Run the updated heatmap
pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix_scaled,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  show_colnames = FALSE,         
  cluster_rows = TRUE,           
  cluster_cols = my_hclust,      
  color = my_palette,           # <--- Force high-contrast colors
  breaks = my_breaks,           # <--- Force symmetric limits
  main = "Physiological Profiles Ordered by Custom CBB Dendrogram"
)
```

```{r}
#plot ED50 by cluster assignment, here K=12
#1. set order for easy interpretation 
custom_order <- c("1", "2", "3", "4", "10", "11", "5", "6", "7", "8", "9", "12")

# --- 2. Clean Data & Reorder Factor Levels ---
df_sorted <- df_modeling %>%
  filter(ED50 < 45) %>% 
  mutate(
    # Force K_12 to follow your specific sequence on the x-axis
    K_12_sorted = factor(as.character(K_12), levels = custom_order),
    species_color = toupper(trimws(species))
  ) %>%
  # Drop any rows that don't match your custom level list (if any exist)
  filter(!is.na(K_12_sorted))

# --- 3. Build the Single Unfaceted Plot ---
plot_sorted_k12 <- ggplot(df_sorted, aes(x = K_12_sorted, y = ED50)) +
  # One clean boxplot per cluster step along your custom x-axis order
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", fill = "grey98") +
  
  # Scatter individual dots colored by species
  geom_jitter(aes(color = species_color), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, size = 2.5) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  labs(
   # title = "ED50 Phenotypes Ordered by Custom Cluster Sequence",
    x = "K_12 Cluster Assignment",
    y = expression(ED[50]*" Score"),
    color = "Species"
  )

# Save the plot with a wide canvas ratio to accommodate the 12 columns
ggsave(here("Plots", "ED50_K12_boxplot_Sorted.png"), plot = plot_sorted_k12, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
